finding.title: Make hierarchy_selection_panel.dart's breadcrumb separator direction-aware
finding.why: In RTL/Hebrew-Terms mode this breadcrumb trail reads right-to-left but always renders a right-pointing chevron, so the separators point the wrong reading direction — exactly the bug already found and fixed in the sibling widget (see breadcrumb_navigation.dart's breadcrumbSeparatorIcon helper and its 'R2 finding 4' comment in content_hierarchy_screen.dart). This widget is consumed by bulk_mark_screen.dart (a churn HOTSPOT), step_bulk_mark.dart (track setup wizard), and lifetime_marking_screen.dart, all real onboarding/settings flows.
finding.recommendation: Import breadcrumbSeparatorIcon from breadcrumb_navigation.dart and replace the hardcoded Icon(Icons.chevron_right, ...) at hierarchy_selection_panel.dart:228-232 with Icon(breadcrumbSeparatorIcon(Directionality.of(context)), ...).
acceptance_criteria: a Locale('he')/TextDirection.rtl widget test for HierarchySelectionPanel (or bulk_mark_screen.dart) asserts Icons.chevron_left is used, not Icons.chevron_right
grep for a bare 'Icons.chevron_right' inside this file (outside a direction-aware helper call) returns no hits
